texte.intro: Imagine your team gets AI colleagues who actually get work done – securely, on your own server. This is AI Employee.
texte.agenten: Every agent has a clear role, such as marketing, research or personal assistant. With its own computer, its own tools and its own memory.
texte.auftrag: You give the task in plain language, just like you would to a colleague. The agent researches, writes – and delivers the result right in the chat.
texte.nachhaken: Not quite right yet? Just follow up.
texte.kontrolle: And you stay in control: for every capability, you decide whether the agent may use it, only with your approval – or not at all.
texte.stufen: How independently it works, you set in four levels – from read only to fully autonomous.
texte.freigaben: Anything sensitive waits for your decision in Approvals.
texte.aufgaben: Plan recurring work once – the agent handles the rest on schedule. And every result stays traceable.
texte.dashboard: The dashboard shows what your team delivers – and what it costs. Budgets cap spending automatically.
texte.outro: AI Employee. Your AI team – on your own infrastructure. In the browser and as an iPhone app. Request your demo today.
